@Huqqa Lounge 

I recently visited Huqqa Lounge, and overall, it was a vibe. The atmosphere was sleek and upscale—the lighting, the decor, the music—all created a modern yet laid-back environment that’s perfect for a night out.

As for the food—it was alright. Nothing bad at all, but it was your standard Arabic cuisine. Tasty enough, but nothing that really stood out or felt unique. If you're going for the food specifically, manage your expectations a bit.

Service-wise, it wasn’t the most attentive that night, but to be fair, there was a big game on and the place was packed. It felt a bit slower than expected. I’d imagine on a regular night it would be smoother.

The crowd was stylish, the vibe was right, and it struck a nice balance between social and chill.

text:
🐟 Phillies Finest Fried Fish Platter That Stole My Heart 🐟

Y’all… we all know why we go to Phillies Finest 👀😂 but let me put y’all on to a new reason to pull up to 1424 North 20th Street in Philadelphia.

I went in for something totally different (mind ya business 😏), but walked out with a fried fish platter that completely changed my life. And here’s the gag… I don’t even like fish. I don’t eat it. I don’t order it. I don’t even think about it. But THIS fried fish? BABYYYY — seasoned to absolute perfection. Crispy on the outside, melt-in-your-mouth soft on the inside, and flavor that’ll make you hum like your grandma on Sunday. 🎶🔥

It was iconic. Breathtaking. A spiritual experience. 🙌🏾

Nia behind the counter spotted me, recognized my content, and next thing I know the amazing owner is offering me a platter. I was beyond grateful — and now I’m telling y’all: go for what you normally go for… but stay for the plates. Because yes, he’s got jerk chicken, fried fish, curry dishes, and more — all made with love, all affordable, all supporting a small Black-owned business right here in Philly.

Pull up, grab a platter, and tell them JASTINATIONS sent you. 🖤✨
